name: zanker-dependency-mocking
description: Supply deterministic providers and mock APIs to reproduce component behavior without production services.

workflow.instruction: Identify runtime dependencies before attempting mock.
Prefer adapting existing DI/providers, Storybook decorators or MSW handlers.
Use synthetic fixtures and explicit roles, flags and locales.
Record mocked dependencies and validate with integrated runtime before claiming parity.

fallback: Use native project dev environment if provider cannot be safely simulated.
